title: openai-responses-compat: passthrough seed/determinism + metadata for Responses variants
author: Priya Shah
description:
Summary: Add OpenAI Responses compatibility for newer endpoint features: ensure seed/determinism flags are forwarded to the serving runtime, pass through arbitrary metadata fields attached to responses and to function/tool calls, and stabilize streaming output for Responses-style streaming variants. Motivation: customers are migrating from OpenAI Responses API to Redwood's OpenAI-compatible surface; they expect deterministic options (seed/randomness control) and metadata passthrough (request_id, tags, provenance) to survive the compatibility layer. This change also fixes streaming stalls observed when Responses-style 'delta' events were interleaved with function call chunks.

What this PR does:
- API layer: accept Responses-style payload fields ("seed", "deterministic", "metadata") on create responses endpoints and map them to internal inference config.
- Streaming: normalize event ordering and flush logic for delta events + function/tool call events to prevent stalls in client SDKs. Adds explicit "event: done" sentinel in the compatibility mapper when appropriate.
- Tools/function-calling: forward metadata attached to tool call results through to the final response object and to audit logs. Preserve tool_call.name and tool_call.metadata keys.
- Tests: integration tests exercising seed determinism by replaying identical prompts with the same seed and asserting identical token sequences; streaming integration test simulating interleaved deltas and tool chunks.
- Docs: compatibility section in openai-compat docs describing the new flags and migration notes.

Checklist:
- [x] Map Responses seed/deterministic flags to internal sampler config
- [x] Metadata passthrough end-to-end (API -> runtime -> response envelope)
- [x] Streaming ordering fix + sentinel event
- [x] Unit and integration tests added
- [x] Update docs and changelog

Backward compatibility: default behavior unchanged when seed/deterministic not provided. Existing OpenAI-compatible calls continue to work. Edge cases: if customers rely on previous non-deterministic ordering of streaming chunks, behavior may be slightly different (ordering is now normalized for reliability).

Related: pr-19842-openai-responses-compat-seed-metadata-passthrough.json (seed passthrough initial prototype), ENG-1421, SUP-784.

release_notes: OpenAI Responses compatibility: seed/determinism passthrough, metadata passthrough, streaming stability improvements for Responses-style streams. No breaking changes by default; see docs for migration notes.
notes_for_operations: When deploying to Dedicated/Private clusters ensure inference_config 'rng_backend' is present; older autoscaler images may not pick up the new config without restart. Watch streaming-related 503 spikes for first 24h after rollout.
migration_instructions: Clients using OpenAI Responses should be able to set 'seed' or 'deterministic' in their request body; these will be forwarded. If you rely on previous streaming ordering, test in staging as ordering is now normalized for reliability.
performance_impact: minimal; deterministic sampling uses same kernels. Additional metadata passthrough has negligible cost. Streaming normalization adds a small constant overhead per stream event.
